title: Polynomial-time computability of the front map
statement: The map that sends each Boolean word to its prescribed front transformation is computable by a finite Turing machine in polynomial time: there exist a machine and natural numbers $C,c$ such that, on every input of length $n$, it halts with output equal to that transformation and uses exactly $C(n+1)^c$ steps.
